patterns: APPSC asks who killed the last Mauryan (Pushyamitra) and the date (187 BC); source of the Yavana invasion (Gargi Samhita, Mahabhashya, Malavikagnimitram; NOT Mudrarakshasa).
Other PSCs: succession chain Maurya -> Sunga -> Kanva -> Andhras/Satavahanas; Patanjali contemporary of Pushyamitra; Ayodhya inscription = two Ashvamedhas.
Besnagar pillar = Vasudeva only (Heliodorus); Malavikagnimitram protagonist = Agnimitra.
App MCQs include many off-topic dynasty-founder/succession items (Sultanate, Vijayanagara, Chandela) inherited from generic sets.
